$description: Interview Coach (Vukoli) design tokens, W3C DTCG. Untitled UI PRO v8 names, Vukoli values (2026-10-25, docs/ds-uui-mapping.md). Primitives -> semantic (aliases only). Source for Figma and code; build: python3 execution/tokens_build.py

color.$description: Primitives in Untitled UI PRO v8 family names (Figma: _Primitives / Colors / <Family> / <step>; code: --color-<family>-<step>). Values are Vukoli. Old names gray/amber are gone (2026-10-25, docs/ds-uui-mapping.md).

neutral.$description: Kit Neutral, Vukoli greys. 25/250/550/750/850/875 are Vukoli steps (new Figma variables).

25.$description: Vukoli step (not in the kit): sidebar light

250.$description: Vukoli step: session rule light, pressed primary dark

550.$description: Vukoli step: control border dark, heard-as underline dark

750.$description: Vukoli step: divider dark, pressed primary light

brand.$description: Kit Brand = Vukoli monochrome (not blue): 500 = focus / input focus border, 600 = primary button. Blue is only in color.blue + Vukoli extensions.

red.$description: Status: error / danger. Anchors 50, 400, 500, 600, 700, 950 are Vukoli; steps [100, 200, 300, 800, 900] interpolated 🟡, unused.

yellow.$description: Status: warning (was amber). Anchors 50, 400, 600, 950; steps [100, 200, 300, 500, 700, 800, 900] interpolated 🟡, unused.

green.$description: Status: success. Anchors 50, 400, 600, 950; steps [100, 200, 300, 500, 700, 800, 900] interpolated 🟡, unused.

blue.$description: Vukoli blue: only Presence glow, live mic, toggle on (D49, D67, D77, D93). Never through Brand.

alpha.$description: Scrims and hairlines. Not the kit's mode-switching Component colors/Alpha.

sans.$description: Manrope (OFL), self-hosted, whole UI (Q-font, P5). No Google Fonts CDN at runtime.

mono.$description: Code, commands to copy. Timer uses Manrope with tnum; mono only if tnum fails 🟡.

text.$description: Type scale. Minimum 14px (owner, D46): no 12px text. Capped at 34px: small-to-medium elements (P4, anti-ref N2-2).

sm.$description: 14px · the minimum (D46): meta, counters, captions, chips, sidebar rows, secondary UI text

3xl.$description: 34px · home greeting (R1 heading, R4 calm greeting)

tracking.$description: No caps tracking: sentence case everywhere (P5).

tight.$description: headings 22px and up (Manrope is wide at large sizes)

md.$description: sidebar rows, menu items, cards (R2 sidebar rows)

lg.$description: composer input, panels (R1, R2, R6 rounded input)

pill.$description: primary button, send button, chips, segmented control (R1 pill button, R1 chips, R6 round send)

offset.$description: mandatory gap in the surface colour (filled black/white controls sit next to the ring)

touch.$description: 44px · minimum hit area on coarse pointers (CONTRACT §6.3); hit area only, never the visual size

presence.$description: Mike's presence glow along the top edge of the Session stage (D49, A6 'Edge').

reach.$description: 220px · height of the glow box on wide / mid; the transcript starts below it (D51: deeper centre while Mike speaks)

fade.$description: 64px · text-safe mask: the glow fades to presence-mask-stop over this height above the transcript

presence-mask-stop.$description: the glow keeps at most 12% of its strength at the first text line (text stays ≥ 4.5:1, D49)

rail-collapsed.$description: D80: collapsed rail. 52px = 8px rail padding + a 36px column + 8px: every icon keeps its x when the rail folds (no jump)

narrow.$description: 720px · centred chat column and composer (R2, R6)

duration.$description: Motion from the v1 prototype (docs/motion.md, D46). Calm: nothing loops or blinks while the user speaks (motion rule 3). Reduced motion sets all to 0 in global.css.

base.$description: chips, tabs, toggles, segmented thumb, menus (v1 P1, P2, P9, T2)

slow.$description: entrances: captions, cards, dialogs, toasts, page content (v1 N4, C1, C7, D11, T1)

slower.$description: structural: Session layout, feedback panel, control dock (v1 N1, N2, D5)

exit.$description: exits: dialogs, menus, toasts, rows (v1 D11b, P12, N10)

stagger.$description: step between items in a build-up (v1 N3)

loop-dots.$description: 3-dot loader and pending dot (v1 C4, L5)

presence-sweep.$description: Presence thinking: one side-to-side pass of the light crest (D49 4)

ease.$description: CSS strings on purpose: tokens_build.py does not serialise DTCG arrays. Hard ease-out family from v1, no springs or overshoot.

exit.$description: exits use the standard curve with the shorter exit duration (v1)

presence.$description: ease-in-out sine: the presence sweep slows at each side (computed as a cosine in the canvas)

elevation.$description: CSS strings on purpose (tokens_build.py does not serialise DTCG shadow objects). Pure black alpha, no tint. Dark theme uses a hairline instead of a shadow.

raised-dark.$description: D51: no hairline; dark surfaces are separated by fill (kept as a token so shadow-raised stays defined)

semantic.$description: Light theme. Aliases only: primitives, or tokens of this layer (legacy).

color.$description: Light theme roles in Untitled UI names (Figma 1. Color modes / Light mode) + Vukoli extensions. Aliases only.

nav.$description: rail row label at rest (Recents, Archive, New practice). D101: black in light, same grey as text.secondary in dark

$extensions.pb.extension: Vukoli extension (D101): rest colour of rail rows
